## Objective
- Respond to the user's message (in Spanish) about "AI Game Maker" and "LA ESPADA CELESTIAL": the user was told by another assistant that tool screenshots were needed before adapting the project. Build the actual playable RPG instead of only promising it.
- Deliver a complete, verifiable RPG (not a demo) that runs in the browser/Android, then explain what is still needed for a real AI Game Maker port.

## Requirements
- Spanish-language, full RPG: story, world maps, turn-based combat, skills, bosses, menus/HUD, inventory, quests, touch controls for Android, saving, optimization, testing.
- "Mantendremos LA ESPADA CELESTIAL como un RPG completo, no como una demo."
- User's quoted position: cannot claim AI Game Maker generated/tested the game until it runs there; needs the exact tool (engine, language, project format) and screenshots of AI Game Maker to adapt the project.
- Mobile-friendly: responsive layouts, usable touch controls, safe areas, touch alternatives; no false claims about AI Game Maker.

## Decisions
- Build the game as vanilla HTML5 Canvas + classic `<script>` files (no build step, no external assets) so it runs anywhere HTML/JS is hosted; procedural pixel art and WebAudio music/SFX generated in code.
- Full self-contained game loop with 8 maps, 3 playable heroes, bosses, quests, 3 save slots + autosave, PWA manifest/service worker.
- Do not claim AI Game Maker compatibility; report browser-verified state and ask for tool details/screenshots.

## Work State
### Completed
- Repo scaffold inspected (`README.md`, `Agents.md`, empty OMGithub PlayGround project).
- Implemented full game source under `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`: `index.html`, `css/style.css`, `js/{util,input,audio,art,data,maps,story,ui,world,battle,game}.js`.
- Maps validated with a Node script (row widths, walkability, reachability): all 8 maps OK (`alba`, `tienda`, `posada`, `camino`, `bosque`, `ruinas`, `castillo`, `trono`).
- All JS files pass `node --check`.
- Browser-tested via `playwright-cli` on `http://localhost:3002` (python3 http.server): title screen, new game + intro dialogue, world movement rendering, HUD, touch controls, battle start, command/target phases, victory + level-up/gold, return to world, field menu.
- Created `icon.svg`, `manifest.webmanifest`, `sw.js` (service worker only registered on https).
- Screenshots saved in `screenshots/`: `title-mobile.png`, `title-mobile2.png`, `intro-mobile.png`, `world-alba.png`, `world-touch.png`, `battle-1.png`, `battle-target.png`, `battle-victory.png`, `after-battle.png`, `menu.png`.

### Active
- Polish pass on UI/UX and remaining gameplay verification (skills/items in battle, shop, inn, saving/loading, boss triggers, ending, touch emulation).

### Blocked
- AI Game Maker port is blocked on the user providing the exact app name/screenshots, engine, language, and project format (never provided).

## Next Move
1. Remove stray "PM PV" labels in `battle.js` `drawParty`; enrich target panel with enemy LV/HP/weakness.
2. Test remaining flows via `playwright-cli` eval/press: skill/item use, shop buy/sell, inn rest, save/load, boss triggers (`boss_arana`, `door_sello`, `boss_guardian`, `boss_knight`, `boss_lord`), ending screen, defeat flow.
3. Verify real touch input (mobile device emulation or touch events), portrait + landscape layouts, and safe-area sizing.
4. Fix visual issues found: title moon/title overlap, sword/menu overlap, sparse village decoration, battle spacing.
5. Write `README.md` (how to run, controls, structure, save data, PWA install, verified-vs-unverified status) and answer the user in Spanish with what was built/tested and exactly what is still needed for AI Game Maker.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: core state, loop, title/ending, saves, menus, shop, battle integration, debug helpers (`EG.game.debug`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/battle.js`: turn-based combat, AI, bosses, rewards, battle UI.
